title: Block XP - Animal Pens Addon
description: A simple and lightweight mod that negates the XP gained from killing entities in Animal Pen
body:
Animal Pen XP Blocker

This mod is designed for modpacks that want to control the experience gained by players.

Animal Pens is a great mod, but its Animal Pen block can be exploited to generate excessive amounts of XP. This addon focuses exclusively on that issue: it blocks the experience gained when using the Animal Pen block, while keeping loot intact and forcing players to progress by finding XP through other means.

Why use this addon?

By removing the XP exploit from Animal Pens, modpack creators can ensure a more balanced and challenging progression system. Players will still enjoy the loot from Animal Pens, but must seek experience through combat, exploration, or other configured mechanics.
